D: The god of thunder is stripped of his powers and dropped in a small New Mexico town.
P: Serve the drinks when Thor smashes his mug in the diner and asks for another.
S: Crisp pan-fried potato and onion cakes with sour cream
Grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter in small cakes until crisp, with sour cream and chives.
Green chilli cheese dip. Thor asked for a horse.

Melted cheddar and cream cheese stirred with roasted green chillies, tomato and onion, served bubbling hot with warm corn chips. Soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter, then add 2 chopped long green chillies and 1 diced tomato and cook 3 minutes. Lower the heat and stir in 250g cream cheese and 100ml milk until smooth, then add 250g grated cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Season with 1 tsp cumin and salt. Pour into a hot dish, top with coriander and serve with 300g corn chips.
Crisp roast wings glazed with honey, garlic and thyme butter
Chicken wings roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a honey, garlic and thyme glaze.
M: Asgardian feast beef ribs with roast roots
Beef short ribs roasted 5 hours with carrots, parsnips and potatoes in the juices

Beef ribs rubbed with salt and pepper, cooked at 140C for 5 hours, with roasted root vegetables and crusty bread. Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt and cracked pepper. Roast covered at 140C for 5 hours until tender. For the last hour, add chunks of carrot, parsnip and potato to the tray to roast in the juices. Serve on a big board with crusty bread.
Diner pancake, bacon and egg stack
buttermilk rounds layered with rashers and fried eggs, maple syrup, a god's first diner breakfast

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with crisp bacon and fried eggs between the layers, with maple syrup poured over the lot. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml buttermilk into a thick batter. Cook 12 pancakes in a buttered pan over medium heat, about 2 minutes a side. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp and fry 4 eggs sunny side up. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon between the layers and an egg on top, then pour over 125ml maple syrup.
W: Puente Antiguo churros with hot chocolate
Fried churros with a cup of thick hot chocolate for dipping

Piped churros fried crisp, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick, dark hot chocolate sauce for dunking. Boil 250ml water with 30g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 1 egg. Pipe 10cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring smooth, for dipping.
K: Brown sugar iced coffee over vanilla ice cream, cold milk and whipped cream

Strong chilled coffee poured over vanilla ice cream with a splash of milk, topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate. Brew 600ml strong coffee, stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar and chill for at least 1 hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each of 4 tall glasses, then pour over the coffee and 50ml cold milk each. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate over dark chocolate. Serve with a straw and a long spoon, and try not to smash the glass.

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Season well and shape into small flat cakes.
Fry in butter over medium heat until deep golden and crisp, in batches, and serve with sour cream and snipped chives.

Melt the butter with the honey, garlic and thyme.
Toss the hot wings through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter.

steps.text: Cut the paneer into thick fingers and toss with the cornflour and salt.

Toss the hot paneer through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter.

steps.text: Rub the celeriacs with half the oil, the salt and cracked pepper and wrap each in foil with half the butter and thyme.
Roast at 200C for 1 and a half hours.
Toss the carrots, parsnips and potatoes in the rest of the oil, unwrap the celeriacs and roast everything together, basting with the buttery juices.
Cut the celeriacs into wedges and serve on a big board with the roots and crusty bread.
